title: LegalDiscourseSpans
description: Span-level parse of legal text following the LegalDiscourse schema (Spangher et al., NAACL 2024): SUBJECT, OBJECT, PROBE, CONSEQUENCE, TEST, EXCEPTION, DEFINITION, CLASS. Layer 1 of the three-layer looseness architecture: TEST/EXCEPTION/DEFINITION spans are routed to the static screener (layer 2), whose scores are calibrated by the synthetic instrument (layer 3).

relations.description: Optional relations between spans (e.g. a TEST applied to a PROBE; an EXCEPTION modifying a TEST; a TEST referencing a defined CLASS — the DEFINITION-multiplier path).
